status: design complete; private sessions not implemented
verifiedSourceBoundaries: Ordinary core startup acquires a lease and performs policy, recovery and resume-state work before creating JSON persistence.
Vendored rqbit already supports no session persistence with nonpersistent bitfields.
Statistics retention off still has library-settings access and is not a private accounting backend.
Queue, scheduling, accounting and layout operations have independent durable write paths.
Foreground and background native hosts have run-intent persistence paths.
Native library windows currently share one store and the client selects ordinary foreground/background endpoints.
designDecisions: Explicit library/private state ownership; no temporary-folder-and-delete substitute.
Read-only validated policy snapshot, fail-closed networking and no ordinary session startup as fallback.
Separate authenticated foreground helper role; no login restoration or request replay after failure.
Fresh exclusive payload subtree; keep payloads after end/crash and reject initially unsupported file operations.
Separate development workspace/store/import routing and transient sandbox folder authority.
Drain engine-owned work before confirmed session end; preserve normal background transfers.
implementationOrder: Deferred runtime acceptance before production activation
